summary: Button's hover, press and disabled styles are gated on a `data-disabled` attribute Button stamps itself, not on `:enabled`/`:disabled` — `:enabled` never matches an <a>, so a link-rendered Button had no hover at all (#31). The native disabled attribute is still set on <button>. Same specificity as before.

migration.manual: A consumer className that overrides Button's disabled look with `disabled:…` no longer wins; write it as `data-disabled:…` (ChatComposer's send control did exactly this and was updated). Overrides of hover/press written as `enabled:hover:…` should become `not-data-disabled:hover:…`.
